description: Polymarket's own taker fee (NOT gas, slippage, or AlphaPipeline's own charge) for a hypothetical fill of `shares` at `price`, using the official bell-curve formula shares * fee_rate * price * (1 - price). fee_rate is read live from Polymarket's own GET /fee-rate for the exact token_id - never hardcoded, since per-category rates have changed before. Makers pay 0 across every category - this is the taker fee only. Omit price to use the live best book quote for side. Accepts either a raw token_id or a market_slug (+ outcome) to resolve it automatically. Paid in USDC on Base.

market_slug.description: Exact Polymarket market slug, used to resolve token_id automatically.

outcome.description: "yes" (default) or "no" - which side to resolve when using market_slug.

price.description: Hypothetical fill price (0-1 exclusive). Omit to use the live best book quote for side.

shares.description: Hypothetical fill size, in shares. Must be > 0.

side.description: "sell" (default) or "buy" - which side of the book to read price from when price is omitted.

token_id.description: The outcome's CLOB token_id / asset_id, if already known.

name: prediction.polymarket_fee_estimate
